The Vibe

A neighbourhood built on flavour

Barrio means neighbourhood, and that is exactly what we set out to build. Bold Mexican flavours with a South-Cali twist, fresh New Zealand produce, and a table worth sharing.

After-work cocktails, a long lunch, the whole family piling in. Indoor and outdoor seating, a courtyard, a kids menu, and a free function room that seats up to 80 for the big ones.

From the Bar

Best cocktailsin town.

We said it, and the queue at the bar agrees. Slushy and fruit margaritas, sangria by the jug, and a tequila list that goes deep. Compromises are for relationships, not cocktails.
